apparatus.basis: Editor restored ⲓⲛ ⲟⲩⲓⲛ at line 32 start. Completes ⲛⲉϩⲁⲕⲧ̄|ⲓⲛ ('his rays,' Greek ἀκτίς) and supplies verb ⲟⲩⲓⲛⲉ 'pass away' (in glossary) governed by habitual ϣⲁⲣⲉ from line 31.

Editor restored phrase ⲛ̄ⲥⲱϩ ⲍⲙ̄ ⲡⲕⲁⲍ at line 33 start. Lyc. ⲛ̄ⲥⲱϩ = 'behind it/him'; completes the sun-image: not a single ray remains 'behind in the earth' after sunset. Standard Manichaean cosmographic image.
Editor restoration; ⲥⲁⲩϩ ⲁϩⲟⲩⲛ 'gather inward' is the standard Coptic idiom for collective ingathering, fitting the apostle's eschatological gathering of the elect.
Editor restoration of final ⲕ in the emphatic doubled pronoun ⲁⲛⲁⲕ ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲩ ⲁⲛⲁⲕ '(I), I and they, I' setting up the unity-formula in line 12.
Editor restoration of final ⲩ. The 3pl suffix is required by the following ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ 'all of them' at line 13.

notes.decision: Translated 'without leaving a single ray.' ⲙⲁϩⲕⲁ analyzed as Lyc. negative-perfect 'they did not leave' (= Sah. ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲕⲁ) or as privative ⲙⲁ-ϩ̄ⲕⲁ 'not-leaving.' The construction with ⲟⲩⲁⲕⲧⲓⲛ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲱⲧ ('a single ray') confirms negative sense in the sunset-image.

Translated 'stand fast' per accumulated glossary entry (ⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗). The perfect ⲉⲧⲁⲓ̈ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲧ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧⲥ̄ 'in which I have stood fast' describes the apostle's incarnational steadfastness within the icon of the flesh.
Translated 'I have manifested forth.' Standard Coptic ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'reveal/manifest forth.' The line-break splits ⲁⲓ̈ⲟⲩⲱ-(line 1)-ⲛϩ̄ (line 2).

Translated 'to depart for myself to the house.' ⲧⲁϣⲉ here read as conjunctive infinitive of a verb of going (Lyc form on the ⲧⲱⲱϣⲉ/ⲧⲁϣⲟ root, or compressed from ⲧⲁϣⲉⲟⲩⲉⲓ 'go far'); the dative ⲛⲏⲓ̈ + directional ⲁⲡⲏⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'to the house of my men' confirms a verb of motion-toward-home. The clause expresses the apostle's eschatological return to the heavenly house of his elect.
Translated 'I say it to you.' The ϯ- prefix marks present-I 'I (am) saying'; ⲓ̈ⲙⲁⲥ = ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲥ '(say) it' (3sg.f. obj.); ⲁⲣⲱⲧⲛ̄ = ⲉⲣⲱⲧⲛ̄ 'to you (pl.).'

Translated 'my Wisdom is anointed in them.' ⲧⲁϩⲥ̄ qualitative of ⲧⲱϩⲥ̄ 'anoint, smear, be anointed.' The qualitative naming the indwelling-state of Wisdom in the elect coheres with Manichaean cosmology of light-particles seated within the chosen.
Translated 'shall be joined with them.' ⲧⲱϩ here in conjunctive 'be joined, mingled' (Lyc.) — distinct from ⲧⲱϩⲥ̄ 'anoint' in line 12. With ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲩ 'with them' the unitive sense is required.
